answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, at each epoch, evaluate a committed identity polynomial whose secret is bound to a Semaphore leaf and an RLN rate-limit nullifier. Each message proves membership and compliant use without disclosing identity; two messages reusing a nullifier expose two polynomial shares, allowing Shamir reconstruction of the agent’s private key and instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus every forge attempt faces a tide of loss, placing sybil resistance at its zenith.
